name: Mexican-Style Black Bean, Corn, Jalapeño & Cilantro Soup with Avocado
ingredients: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery; trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

While the pot heats up, quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Small dice and add to the bowl with the veggies. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the veggies are soft, add flour and spices to the pot; continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add beans, broth, and tomato sauce to the pot. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, halve, and thinly slice radishes crosswise; place in the reserved bowl. Drizzle with vinegar, sprinkle with salt, and stir to combine; set aside to marinate.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, add cilantro, corn, and additional vinegar to the pot; stir to combine the soup and continue to simmer until heated through, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh.
To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with pickled radish, avocado, and feta. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
